Trace spotter

Read an agent’s execution trace and mark every step that breaks a rule: taint, approval drift, wrong audience, token passthrough, egress, replay, scope. Then compare with a reference checker you can read and port.

#EventLogged fieldsYour callResult

The reference checker

Plain rules over the logged fields. Notice what it needs the log to record: hashes, audiences, scopes, nonces and whether content was isolated. If your logs lack those, no checker can help.
